Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Do you want to develop the skills to excel in leadership and management roles across the health and care sector, but aren’t not sure if you’re ready for university study? Then our health and care management degree with an integrated foundation year is the solution you’ve been looking for. Designed to equip you with the skills you need to progress to degree-level study, this programme will help you establish a career within the health and social care sector, even if you don’t have the academic qualifications to join a standard undergraduate degree course. The foundation year is perfect if you need a little extra support to start your journey to higher education, offering study-skills and guidance at every stage. In addition to being a high quality honours degree, the course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute (CMI). That means that upon successful completion, you’ll receive the CMI Level 5 Diploma in Management and Leadership, demonstrating your ability to succeed in health and social care management roles. Progress towards IHSCM Fellowship as part of your degree The course is endorsed by the Institute of Health & Social Care Management (IHSCM), meaning it’s recognised for its excellence in teaching both management and health and social care skills. Your studies are aligned with IHSCM fellowship requirements, meaning the work you complete as part of your degree contributes directly towards the fellowship pathway. Unlike the standard route, you won’t need to complete additional applications, CPD submissions, or external activities, as Arden monitors your progress and awards the relevant recognition as you advance through the course. The academic team behind the development and delivery of the course are industry leaders with vast experience within the health and social care sector, including directors at the NHS/IHSCM and digital health tech firms, ensuring the course is directed by the needs of the industry. This also brings a wealth of professional expertise to your learning, providing you with a myriad of opportunities to develop your skills and practice. Finally, guest lecturers and live case studies from our links with the NHS, IHSCM, and Skills for Care will help you learn from real-world experiences and connect with professionals in the field. Health and Care Management at Arden Video • 1 min Accreditation and Memberships CMI Accredited This course awards a CMI Level 5 Diploma in Management & Leadership and offers CMI Foundation Chartered Manager Status. IHSCM Endorsed This course offers IHSCM student membership, giving you access to a diverse range of workshops, conferences and networking opportunities. You’ll also be eligible to achieve IHSCM Fellowship while completing your course. Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional accreditation This course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute, supporting your career and connecting you with likeminded professionals. Learn more Course details and modules Arden's foundation year modules have been designed to give you a tailored and fully supportive introduction to university study. This first year of study will prepare you for success in higher education by introducing you to the academic skills and subject-specific knowledge required to excel in your chosen degree subject. An innovative approach to health and care management is the only answer to the extensive changes the sector has experienced in the last years. The course has been developed in correspondence with the ever-growing needs of the health and social care sector, highlighting the emerging digital and leadership competencies required of today’s professionals and managers. So, if you’re looking for a quality health and social care-oriented degree that will help you take on the sector’s most pressing workplace matters with confidence, look no further than our BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management with Foundation Year. I chose online learning because I do not currently have the capacity to attend classes as my days are full with running my household, my elderly parents’ household and tending to the needs of my 3-year-old. Online studying has been extremely helpful because it provides the flexibility I need in order to study at random times during the day or night. Cynthia Blow BSc (Hons) Psychology Modules Foundation year Preparing for University Success (20 credits) Exploring the Business Environment (20 credits) Advancing your Academic Skills (20 credits) Becoming an Effective Leader (20 credits) Planning for Your Future Success (20 credits) Investigation & Innovation Project (20 credits) Level 4 Essential Skills for Health & Care Management (20 credits) Meeting the Needs of Service Users (20 credits) Planetary Health (20 credits) Health Promotion (20 credits) Supporting Dignity and Respect Through Ethical Principles and Theories (20 credits) Communication & Interprofessional Collaboration (20 credits) Level 5 Leadership Theory & Concepts for Health & Care Management (20 credits) Fundamentals of Health & Care Finance (20 credits) Public Health (20 credits) Resource Planning in Multidisciplinary Working (20 credits) Digital Health Leadership (20 credits) Evidence Based Practice (20 credits) Level 6 Global Health and Sustainability (20 credits) Health Analytics and Planning (20 credits) Total Quality Management in Health & Care (20 credits) Project Management (20 credits) Independent Study for Health and Care Management (20 credits) Coaching and Leadership (20 credits) How do we assess you? Assessments Unlike on more traditional degrees, you won't be sitting any exams on this course. Your assessments will instead link your learning material to health, care, and management practice, providing you with key transferable workplace attributes for your future role. These include: Essay and personal development plan Presentations Digital badges Reflection on practice Analysis report Podcast Resource for ‘Care Quality Commission’ (CQC) inspection Leadership consultancy report Portfolio of finance tasks and calculations Critical case study review and CARS checklist analysis Study options This course is available to study through Arden’s blended learning study mode. Daytime classes are available in London Ealing , London Stratford , London Holborn , Manchester , Birmingham , Nottingham and Leeds . Evening classes are available in London Tower Hill, London Holborn, Leeds, Manchester and Birmingham campuses. Friday Evening and Saturdays are another option. You’ll have one class on a Friday evening and one class on Saturday each week. These are available in London Stratford and Leeds campuses. I chose to study with Arden University because the staff members were really supportive and nice. The course also fitted around my job. With Arden, I’ve finally learned to cope and understand my learning pattern, and my dyslexia. I’m on a Blended Learning degree, which involves a couple of days a week in the classroom with other students and tutors at Arden’s University centre in Ealing, West London plus fully supported online study. Cemene Wellington BA (Hons) Healthcare Graduation Stories: Charlene Read now Full-time blended learning How does it work? Our blended learning degree combines interactive, face-to-face campus teaching with flexible online study via iLearn , our 24/7 digital campus. Campus schedule : Attend 8 hours of timetabled classes each week at your chosen UK campus. You can spread your classes over 2 days per week , or choose our new 1-day-per-week option if you are studying a Foundation Year degree course. Independent study: Complement your campus classes with approximately 32 hours per week of self-guided study, module activities, and assessment prep on iLearn. Free study materials: Access our digital Library Portal featuring thousands of e-books, journals, and databases, which are all provided completely free of charge, saving you the cost of expensive textbooks. Blended learning is ideal for students who want the structure of regular face-to-face classes alongside the flexibility to fit full-time study around work, family, and personal commitments. Fees and funding Because blended learning is a full-time study mode , you remain eligible for full UK student finance: Students in England: You can apply for both a Tuition Fee Loan and a Maintenance Loan to help cover your living costs. Students in Scotland, Wales, & Northern Ireland: Funding is available through your regional student finance body. For full details on eligibility and how to apply, visit our Fees and Funding page . Learn more about blended learning Introducing your Digital Backpack Once you’ve enrolled on your psychology degree with Arden you’ll get access to your Digital Backpack, a toolkit of digital resources we’ve put together to help you succeed during your time studying with us. Here are some of the digital resources you’ll have available throughout your course: Office 365 subscription Integrated zoom video conferencing Careers support available through Arden Futures, your careers platform, to help you throughout your career journey whether you are a Career Starter, Changer or Developer. Perlego online library access giving you access to over half a million books, journals and articles BPS resources and support NVIVO, SPSS and GORILLA industry software Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Eligibility To be eligible for our BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management with Foundation Year course, we need to see that you have: A minimum of 45 credits at Level 3 completed within the last 3 years, or equivalent. If you don’t meet these requirements, your application may be considered based on a minimum of 2 years of professional work experience evidenced with a CV and reference. In addition, an apprenticeship route: the Chartered Manager Degree Apprenticeship BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management (CMI) with NHS Mary Seacole Award is also available. English proficiency IELTS 6.0 or equivalent (no less than 5.5 in any element). Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English, such as a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English can be accepted. Meet the faculty Dr. Stephanie West joined Arden University in November 2020 and is the Head of the School of School of Leadership & Service Industry Management. In addition to her wealth of healthcare industry experience, Stephanie has held a number of Senior Academic and Leadership positions in Health, Social Care and Applied Science faculties at a variety of universities across the UK. Stephanie will provide leadership to the School of School of Leadership & Service Industry Management, ensuring that it delivers high quality academic provision and student satisfaction across all courses. Professor Stephanie West Head of School - School of Leadership & Service Industry Management Career prospects The BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management with Foundation Year provides students with not only just a degree, but the CMI Level 5 Diploma in Leadership and Management. This will allow you to gain key qualifications and professional competence in health and care management and leadership to start or enhance your career. This qualification is accepted by the CQC and Skills for Care in application for Registered Manager positions in social care, demonstrating the quality of the course from both a management and health and care perspective. Related articles Health and Social Care Articles Career Advice Related Courses BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management BA (Hons) Healthcare Management (Top-Up) BA (Hons) Business Management (Human Resource Management) What will the BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management with Foundation Year do for me? With the introduction of integrated care systems, the demand for highly trained professionals and managers in health and social care will most certainly increase. Our unique offering combines health and care with management principles, providing a foundation for you to both develop and build new skills for your current or future managerial roles. This includes those working or aspiring to work within NHS Trusts, social care, private clinics, charitable sectors, or within local councils or the wider health profession. So, whether you’re looking for a career change, to develop new skills, or career progression, the course offers a pathway for you to achieve your ambitions. On top of this, gaining CMI status opens new doors for professionals in the field and can act as a fast-track to career development and progression. You’ll also be eligible to achieve IHSCM Fellowship as part of your studies, helping you build recognised professional status within the health and social care sector as you graduate. Upon graduation, you may find yourself managing a health or social care setting, developing public health campaigns or policy, researching key health and care issues, working in medical technology, developing quality assurance practises, or even working in community health care development. During your Foundation Year, you'll get comprehensive support and preparation for your university journey, including: Introduction and preparation: our Foundation Year courses introduce you to university-level teaching, learning, and assessment methods. You'll develop essential study skills, research techniques, and critical thinking abilities, laying a strong foundation for your degree studies. Personalised support: our academic staff will guide you throughout your Foundation Year. They'll ensure a smooth transition into your degree programme, providing the support you need every step of the way. Direct relevance to your future degree: your programme content is carefully designed to align with Arden's degree courses. Studying a Foundation Year will equip you with subject-specific knowledge and interdisciplinary exploration, establishing a solid base for your chosen degree. Improved degree outcomes: we prioritise not only your academic preparation but also your success. By boosting your confidence, academic skills, and understanding of the subjects, we empower you to achieve the best possible degree outcomes and expand your career opportunities. What can I do after Arden University? With a health and care bachelor’s degree under your belt, you could work in the National Health Service (NHS), in the vast social care sector, with a private healthcare provider, or for a voluntary or not-for-profit organisation in a range of settings, including: Health service management Social care Registered Manager roles Service implementation, improvement, or transformation Health and care funding opportunities and applications Strategy development Communications and engagement Partnership or collaboration building Training needs management Workforce development Service user/patient experience liaison or engagement Quality assessment Health promotion and education Public health initiatives System design and implementation Digital health enterprises Data planning Industry skills Chartered Management Institute (CMI) This course awards a CMI Level 5 Diploma in Management & Leadership and offers CMI Full Chartered Manager Status * The Chartered Management Institute (CMI) promotes excellence in UK management and leadership. As the CMI possesses a Royal Charter, they are the only organisation in the UK that can award Chartered Manager status to their members – the gold standard in management. With 140,000 members, the institute aims to boost career development across the management sector and connect like-minded professionals. As an Arden student, you’ll have free CMI Membership throughout your studies, giving you access to a range of additional resources including a mentoring service and invitations to networking events both online and offline. Upon completion of this CMI-accredited course, you will be awarded CMI Level 5 Diploma in Management & Leadership and gain CMI Full Chartered Manager Status. This recognises you have the skills needed to be an effective manager, helping you stand out from the competition and start your management career journey - with a CMI qualification and a clear pathway to full Chartered Manager status. *Upon completion of your course, the CMI award and level of chartered status awarded will depend on your level and length of study, whether you entered your course with Recognition for Prior Learning (RPL) or if any compensation is applied on your modules throughout the duration of study. If this criteria applies to you, you may receive one of the 2 different levels; an Award or Certificate. Institute of Health & Social Care Management (IHSCM) This course is endorsed by the Institute of Health & Social Care Management, whose aim is to create a supportive professional body that is relevant in its activities and modern in its approach and who holds sector leaders in the NHS, social care, third sector and private healthcare amongst its members. Your studies are aligned with IHSCM fellowship requirements, meaning the work you complete as part of your degree contributes directly towards the fellowship pathway. IHSCM Fellowship is then awarded based on your successful progression through the programme. The IHSCM works with Arden University to contribute to curriculum development and delivery. As an Arden student, you’ll become a student member of the Institute, giving you access to a diverse range of events, conferences, workshops and networks as well as opportunities for mentoring and coaching. Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) membership. Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). AACSB International is a global association of leaders in education and business dedicated to supporting and advancing quality business education worldwide. This membership reflects the fact that Arden University has successfully matched the high standards required by the AACSB, and enables the sharing of ideas and the exchange best practises between global business schools. Membership also gives our faculty members access to in-depth data and research to support the development of our courses and teaching methods, ensuring that we are able to provide you with the best possible university experience. Business Graduates Association (BGA) The BGA is a membership and quality assurance body. As a member, Arden University have signed up to the BGA Charter, committing their institution to responsible management practices and lifelong learning, positively impacting their students, communities, and the economy. This shows our students that we are demonstrating responsible management ourselves, as well as it being a central theme that runs through our own courses. As Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), students will receive complementary BGA student and graduate membership. Through this membership, current students will have access to the BGA Career Development Centre, packed with interactive tools, e-learning content, partner discounts and the latest job opportunities. This is a lifetime access, which means students will continue to have access to these services even after they graduate. Undergraduate Award Foundation Year Entry Degrees Full time 4 years Location Berlin Apply today Speak to an advisor Download Brochure Faculty of Business What makes Arden University special? Experience Student Life in Berlin Berlin combines world-class culture, creativity, and international energy with a vibrant student community. It's a city that offers opportunities to grow both academically and personally. Modern Learning Support with iLearn Your studies are supported by digital learning resources that help you prepare for classes, review materials, and stay connected with your programme throughout your studies. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Do you want to develop the skills to excel in leadership and management roles across the health and care sector, but aren’t not sure if you’re ready for university study? Then our health and care management degree with an integrated foundation year is the solution you’ve been looking for. Designed to equip you with the skills you need to progress to degree-level study, this programme will help you establish a career within the health and social care sector, even if you don’t have the academic qualifications to join a standard undergraduate degree course. The foundation year is perfect if you need a little extra support to start your journey to higher education, offering study-skills and guidance at every stage. In addition to being a high quality honours degree, the course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute (CMI). That means that upon successful completion, you’ll receive the CMI Level 5 Diploma in Management and Leadership, demonstrating your ability to succeed in health and social care management roles. Progress towards IHSCM Fellowship as part of your degree The course is endorsed by the Institute of Health & Social Care Management (IHSCM), meaning it’s recognised for its excellence in teaching both management and health and social care skills. Your studies are aligned with IHSCM fellowship requirements, meaning the work you complete as part of your degree contributes directly towards the fellowship pathway. Unlike the standard route, you won’t need to complete additional applications, CPD submissions, or external activities, as Arden monitors your progress and awards the relevant recognition as you advance through the course. The academic team behind the development and delivery of the course are industry leaders with vast experience within the health and social care sector, including directors at the NHS/IHSCM and digital health tech firms, ensuring the course is directed by the needs of the industry. This also brings a wealth of professional expertise to your learning, providing you with a myriad of opportunities to develop your skills and practice. Finally, guest lecturers and live case studies from our links with the NHS, IHSCM, and Skills for Care will help you learn from real-world experiences and connect with professionals in the field. Health and Care Management at Arden Video • 1 min Accreditation and Memberships CMI Accredited This course awards a CMI Level 5 Diploma in Management & Leadership and offers CMI Foundation Chartered Manager Status. IHSCM Endorsed This course offers IHSCM student membership, giving you access to a diverse range of workshops, conferences and networking opportunities. You’ll also be eligible to achieve IHSCM Fellowship while completing your course. Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Professional accreditation This course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute, supporting your career and connecting you with likeminded professionals. Learn more Course details and modules An innovative approach to health and care management is the only answer to the extensive changes the sector has experienced in the last years. The course has been developed in correspondence with the ever-growing needs of the health and social care sector, highlighting the emerging digital and leadership competencies required of today’s professionals and managers. So, if you’re looking for a quality health and social care-oriented degree that will help you take on the sector’s most pressing workplace matters with confidence, look no further than our BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management with Foundation Year. I chose Arden University Berlin because they provide an environment to further your knowledge and pursue opportunities in a new field. Jasvir Markandy MSc IT Security Management graduate, Arden University Berlin Modules Foundation year: Preparing for University Success (20 credits) Exploring the Business Environment (20 credits) Advancing your Academic Skills (20 credits) Becoming an Effective Leader (20 credits) Planning for Your Future Success (20 credits) Investigation & Innovation Project (20 credits) Level 4: Essential Skills for Health & Care Management (20 credits) Meeting the Needs of Service Users (20 credits) Planetary Health (20 credits) Health Promotion (20 credits) Supporting Dignity and Respect Through Ethical Principles and Theories (20 credits) Communication & Interprofessional Collaboration (20 credits) Level 5: Leadership Theory & Concepts for Health & Care Management (20 credits) Fundamentals of Health & Care Finance (20 credits) Public Health (20 credits) Resource Planning in Multidisciplinary Working (20 credits) Digital Health Leadership (20 credits) Evidence Based Practice (20 credits) Level 6: Global Health and Sustainability (20 credits) Health Analytics and Planning (20 credits) Total Quality Management in Health & Care (20 credits) Project Management (20 credits) Independent Study for Health and Care Management (20 credits) Coaching and Leadership (20 credits) How do we assess you? Assessments Unlike on more traditional degrees, you won't be sitting any exams on this course. Your assessments will instead link your learning material to health, care, and management practice, providing you with key transferable workplace attributes for your future role. These include: Essay and personal development plan Presentations Digital badges Reflection on practice Analysis report Podcast Resource for ‘Care Quality Commission’ (CQC) inspection Leadership consultancy report Portfolio of finance tasks and calculations Critical case study review and CARS checklist analysis Final project Study options I learn better face-to-face, so Arden gives me an opportunity to do both face-to-face learning and guided self-study. This is better for me because I need time for my daughter as well as my studies, so now I have time for both. Nkechi Mathilda Nwobi MSc Project Management student, Arden University Berlin Full-time study in Berlin How does it work? Full-time study in Berlin is ideal for students who want to benefit from regular face-to-face teaching and learning alongside their tutors and classmates. You’ll study at our Berlin campus, where teaching takes place in person and attendance in Berlin is required throughout your studies. Alongside your scheduled classes, you’ll also use our online learning platform, iLearn, to access study materials and support your independent learning. Studying in Berlin also gives you the opportunity to experience life as an international student in one of Europe’s most dynamic and historic cities. Learn more about full-time study in Berlin Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. What do you need to study with us? Our aim is to make learning as accessible as possible by ensuring that you can join us, wherever you are. That's why we keep our requirements simple. All you need is a laptop or computer (we recommend one running the latest version of Windows), and a good stable internet connection. With this one tool, you'll be able to access information, advice, support, learning materials and our online library, as well as create assignments, keep notes, and collaborate with other students effectively. Eligibility To be eligible for our BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management with Foundation Year course, we need to see that you have: At least 3 x GCSEs OR 45 credits at Level 2 or equivalent – if your qualifications are older than 3 years we would also ask to see a professional CV. If you don’t meet these requirements, your application may be considered based on a minimum of 12 months of professional work experience evidenced with a CV and reference. In addition, an apprenticeship route: the Chartered Manager Degree Apprenticeship BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management (CMI) with NHS Mary Seacole Award is also available. English proficiency IELTS 5.5 or equivalent (no less than 5.0 in any element or TOEFL 46-59 or equivalent). Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English, such as a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English can be accepted. Meet the faculty A degree from Arden University is your first step towards a rewarding position in the healthcare field. Our health and social care academic staff members have years of experience working in, studying, and researching their fields. We bring our own first-hand knowledge and professional expertise to the course, which adds even more value to your learning experience. I look forward to welcoming you to the Arden University family. Saikou Sanyang Deputy Head of School/ Principal Lecturer Career prospects The BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management provides learners with not only just a degree, but the CMI Level 5 Diploma in Leadership and Management. This will allow learners to gain key qualifications and professional competence in health and care management and leadership to start or enhance their careers. Average Annual Salary for a Health Service Manager in Germany is €58,000*. Average Annual Salary for a Clinic Manager in Germany is €66,440*. Average Annual Salary for a Healthcare Consultant in Germany is €62,500*. *sourced from PayScale .com, 2024. Related courses BA (Hons) Health and Care Management BA (Hons) Healthcare Management (Top-Up) BA (Hons) Business Management (Human Resource Management) Related articles Health and Social Care Articles Career Advice What will the BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management with Foundation Year do for me? With the introduction of integrated care systems, the demand for highly trained professionals and managers in health and social care will most certainly increase. Our unique offering combines health and care with management principles, providing a foundation for you to both develop and build new skills for your current or future managerial roles. This includes those working or aspiring to work within NHS Trusts, social care, private clinics, charitable sectors, or within local councils or the wider health profession. So, whether you’re looking for a career change, to develop new skills, or career progression, the course offers a pathway for you to achieve your ambitions. On top of this, gaining CMI status opens new doors for professionals in the field and can act as a fast-track to career development and progression. You’ll also be eligible to achieve IHSCM Fellowship as part of your studies, helping you build recognised professional status within the health and social care sector as you graduate. Upon graduation, you may find yourself managing a health or social care setting, developing public health campaigns or policy, researching key health and care issues, working in medical technology, developing quality assurance practises, or even working in community health care development. What can I do after Arden University? With a health and care bachelor’s degree under your belt, you could work in the National Health Service (NHS), in the vast social care sector, with a private healthcare provider, or for a voluntary or not-for-profit organisation in a range of settings, including: Health service management Social care Registered Manager roles Service implementation, improvement, or transformation Health and care funding opportunities and applications Strategy development Communications and engagement Partnership or collaboration building Training needs management Workforce development Service user/patient experience liaison or engagement Quality assessment Health promotion and education Public health initiatives System design and implementation Digital health enterprises Data planning Industry skills Chartered Management Institute (CMI) This course awards a CMI Level 5 Diploma in Leadership and Management. The Chartered Management Institute (CMI) promotes excellence in UK management and leadership. The institute aims to boost career development across the management sector and connect you with like-minded professionals Institute of Health & Social Care Management (IHSCM) This course is endorsed by the Institute of Health & Social Care Management, whose aim is to create a supportive professional body that is relevant in its activities and modern in its approach and who holds sector leaders in the NHS, social care, third sector and private healthcare amongst its members. Your studies are aligned with IHSCM fellowship requirements, meaning the work you complete as part of your degree contributes directly towards the fellowship pathway. IHSCM Fellowship is then awarded based on your successful progression through the programme. The IHSCM works with Arden University to contribute to curriculum development and delivery. As an Arden student, you’ll become a student member of the Institute, giving you access to a diverse range of events, conferences, workshops and networks as well as opportunities for mentoring and coaching. Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) membership. Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). AACSB International is a global association of leaders in education and business dedicated to supporting and advancing quality business education worldwide. This membership reflects the fact that Arden University has successfully matched the high standards required by the AACSB, and enables the sharing of ideas and the exchange best practises between global business schools. Membership also gives our faculty members access to in-depth data and research to support the development of our courses and teaching methods, ensuring that we are able to provide you with the best possible university experience. Skills for Health Skills for Health is the UK's leading authority on skills and workforce development for the health sector. NHS and healthcare employers across the UK collaborate with Skills for Help to develop skills, roles, competencies, and strategies that provide better patient outcomes. They champion the entire workforce. The Quality Mark is the UK’s benchmark for exceptional healthcare training and development. Being endorsed by the Quality Mark ensures that an organisation's training is world class, and has passed a rigorous review process of its delivery, strategy, and quality assurance practices. Business Graduates Association (BGA) Arden University’s Faculty of Business is an esteemed member institution of the Business Graduates Association (BGA). Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Full support both online and on-site We're also proud to offer non-standard entry, meaning your work experience and previous qualifications are taken into account when assessing your application. Strong focus on employability You will gain in-depth subject knowledge and transferable skills that employers from a huge range of industries will value. Many of our courses at Arden are also accredited by leading professional bodies in the UK. Course Overview Are you ready to accelerate your career in one of the most in-demand and financially rewarding fields today? Arden University's MSc Cyber Security programme is aligned with the NCSC academic framework and equips you with the skills necessary to thrive in highly lucrative cyber security roles. In recent studies, 57% of businesses said they currently have unfilled cyber security positions* , and 1.8 million jobs in the field went unfilled in 2022 alone**. With such huge skills gaps and a burgeoning demand for cyber experts across the globe, this course will arm you with the knowledge you need to excel as an expert in cyber security across almost limitless industries. What you'll learn Our programme goes deep into cyber security, covering everything from understanding core concepts and standards to identifying vulnerabilities and risks within modern networks and infrastructures. You'll gain the expertise to design secure systems, making them resilient against potential attacks. We'll also teach you the technical skills needed to become an ethical hacker and proactive security tester, as well as how to perform digital forensics and incident management. Additionally, you'll explore cloud, web, and mobile security concepts, becoming adept at recognising critical threats. We emphasise hands-on learning, allowing you to apply essential security techniques to test and protect against real-world attacks and recommend improvements. Beyond the basics Our commitment to your success goes beyond the classroom. Arden University offers access to industry-leading resources and certifications, such as Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals and Microsoft Azure Security Technologies. We cover the costs of these resources, so you only pay for your exams in many cases, making your degree great value for money. Arden University is a Cisco Network Academy, providing you with access to free Cisco resources. You can self-study for Cisco courses and receive badges in key areas such as networking, Python and Linux that you can add to your CV. Arden is also an AWS Academy, so you’ll gain access to further free course content to complement your degree. Award-Winning Cyber Security Programme Arden University stands among the world’s leading cybersecurity education providers, having received the 2025 EC Council Academia Circle of Excellence Award, a global mark of quality awarded to only a small number of institutions each year. Chosen from thousands of academic partners, this recognition showcases our dedication to innovative teaching, practical learning experiences, and strong certification outcomes. This means that by joining Arden you’ll study at a university that meets the highest international standards and is focused on preparing graduates for impactful careers in the rapidly growing cybersecurity sector. * Future of the Cybersecurity Job Market 2022 ** The Cybersecurity Skills Gap Won't Be Solved in a Classroom Why choose Arden Video • 1 min Accreditation and Memberships Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) This certification is a comprehensive programme that trains individuals in ethical hacking and penetration testing techniques. Cisco Networking Academy Arden University is a Cisco Network Academy. On our MSc Cyber Security, you’ll receive Cisco resources so you can self-study and add many of the Cisco networking, cyber, coding, and OSes digital badges to your CV. Quick tools Explore your brochure Download the course brochure to take a look at your course modules and syllabus content. Download brochure Speak to an advisor Want to speak to one of our subject experts? Our advisors are ready to answer your questions! Click below to get started. Show me how Added industry skills Add to your skills with access to certified courses from Salesforce, Cisco, and Amazon. Find out how Course details and modules Our MSc Cyber Security course delivers exciting and up-to-date module content that guarantees you’ll develop essential workplace skills. Just a few course highlights embedded into your modules include: Building networks: Gain hands-on experience using Cisco IOS simulation software to design secure networks. You'll configure devices like firewalls, switches, and routers, ensuring network safety. Learn ethical hacking: Master ethical hacking with industry-standard tools like MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, and Metasploit. Master digital forensics: Learn professional digital forensics and incident management skills, including evidence acquisition and analysis using industry-standard tools. Maintain ethical and legal standards during investigations. Find and mitigate risk from vulnerabilities: Explore common cyber security vulnerabilities and apply mitigations using OWASP Top 10 guidelines. Meeting the tutors and students online and then having the opportunity to meet again in person is such an incredible experience. The courses are well explicated and the tutors are great. Classes are engaging and students are supportive of each other. I’m proud to be an Arden student and I would certainly recommend this course to others. Youssef Yehya MSc Strategic Digital Marketing - Berlin Campus The global demand for cybersecurity professionals is surging, highlighting a critical shortage in skilled talent worldwide. Similarly, in the UK, businesses are grappling with significant cybersecurity skills gaps, emphasising the urgent need for qualified professionals to address evolving threats. Global skills gap: The global cyber security market was estimated at $222.66 billion in 2023 and is projected to grow at a compound annual growth rate of 12.3% until 2030. Cyber Security Market Size & Trends Global cybersecurity job vacancies grew 350% between 2013-2021, from 1 million openings to 3.5 million. The number of unfilled jobs remained at 3.5 million in 2023, but the disparity between demand and supply is predicted to persist through at least 2025. Cybersecurity Jobs Report: 3.5 Million Unfilled Positions In 2025 In 2023, research found that the global workforce grew to an all-time high of 5.5 million, an increase of 8.7% and 440,000 jobs compared to 2022. ISC2 Cybersecurity Workforce Study: Looking Deeper into the Workforce Gap UK skills gap: 50% of all UK businesses have a basic cybersecurity skills gap and 33% face advanced skills gaps. There were 160,035 cyber security job postings last year, marking a 30% increase from the previous year. 37% of vacancies were reported as hard-to-fill. An estimated 11,200 more professionals are needed to meet the demand in the cybersecurity workforce. Cyber security skills in the UK labour market 2023 Course Modules Information Security Management (20 credits) Network Security (20 credits) Secure System Design (20 credits) Offensive Security (20 credits) Cloud and Web Services Security (20 credits) Digital Forensics and Incident Management (20 credits) Advanced Computing Project (60 credits) For full details on your module content, click here to download the brochure . A modern assessment strategy This programme has been designed to ensure you undertake a range of practical and authentic assessments. These assessments will be portfolio-based, where you will submit real-world portfolio assets which you have created as a component of each course module using industry-standard tools and practices. This means that by the end of your degree, you’ll have a professional portfolio demonstrating your cyber security knowledge and skills which you can use to provide evidence of your advanced capabilities to employers. Other features of our assessment methodologies include: Practice-driven Your course assessments will be practice-driven, mirroring real-world practitioner skills to ensure that you graduate from your course ready to take on future challenges in cyber security with confidence. The Advanced Computing Project You’ll conclude your degree with your Advanced Computing Project. Here, you'll dive into a hands-on journey, solving real-world computing problems through research, design, and creation. You’ll be allocated a supervisor within your chosen topic area to support you through the project process and in the development of your project proposal – helping you emerge not just with a degree, but with practical industry-ready abilities to demonstrate to employers. Additional study skills through vendor programmes, provided free of charge The following vendor courses will be available for you to study in parallel with your degree. All the material on these programmes is completely free, giving you incredible savings and value for money. You will only need to pay for the final exams if you should choose to take them. Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900) Digital badge with the option to pay for an exam to gain certification Microsoft Azure Security Technologies (AZ-500T00) Digital badge with the option to pay for an exam to gain certification EC Council CEH (ethical hacking) Arden covers the exam cost. Students will only need to pay an administration fee to take it. Multiple Cisco self-study courses Free Digital badges to study Self-study courses with free course content with the option to pay for exams Other additional learning resources you’ll have include: Access to EC Council CEH content, which includes e-books, labs, videos, and the opportunity to take a certification exam. Access to Cisco Packet Tracer, where you can build networks by configuring switches, routers, and firewalls, helping you advance your skills in a practical nature. Hands-on experience with cutting-edge virtual labs EC Council CEH – The supplementary EC Council CEH (ethical hacking) programme is integrated into the MSc syllabus through the Offensive Security and Cloud and Web Services Security modules. You'll also have access to the CEH content for self-study if you choose to take the exam, as well as the following industry-standard skills and tools: Open source/footprinting and scanning tools such as Melegor, Metasploit, Nmap Proxy and enumeration tools such as BurpSuite, Tor, Dig, NFS, SNMP Vulnerability analysis and exploitation tools such as CVSS, Nessus, OpenVas, John the Ripper, Hashcat, PSExec Anti-rootkit and malware generator tools such as Stinger, Divergent, Powershell Sniffers, DDOs, and session hijacking tools such as Wireshark, Cain & Abel, TCP Dump, HULK, OWASP ZAP, sslstrip IDS, anonymisers, and honeypot tools such as Snort, Boomproxy, SPECTOR Wireless, mobile, and IoT tools such as Air Suite, Agent Smith Attack, IoTSeeker Web and cloud tools such as ZAP, Burp AWS pwn, Sysdig Digital forensic tools such as Autopsy, FTK Imager, RegRipper, CAINE TryHackME - Students gain access to TryHackMe, a leading online platform for hands-on cyber security training. This provides a range of benefits designed to enhance your learning experience and help you build real-world skills: Secure Virtual Environment: Practice your skills in a safe, legal, and ethical online environment without needing to install software on your personal devices. Real-World Simulations: Engage in over 750+ labs covering both offensive and defensive security, from beginner to expert level, allowing you to experience realistic cyber security scenarios. Gamified Learning: Make learning interactive and fun with bite-sized lessons and challenges that earn you points, badges, and a spot on global leaderboards. Flexible Access: Study anytime, anywhere with web-based labs that are accessible from any device, making it perfect for distance learners. Custom Learning Paths: Follow tailored learning paths that align with your career goals or focus on specific skills, with the flexibility to explore individual topics at your own pace. Community and Collaboration: Join a global community of over 3 million users, where you can share knowledge, compete in challenges, and collaborate on Capture The Flag exercises. Continuous Access: After completing your studies, maintain your TryHackMe account to access free content or opt for a subscription to continue your professional development. Study options This course is available to study full-time at our campus in Berlin, Germany, or through our blended learning study mode in London Stratford and Manchester. The course is also available to students via online learning . This gives you the convenience of being able to study worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. Part-time online learning How does it work? Studying this course online gives you the ultimate in convenience. You can enrol with Arden from anywhere in the world and study your degree from the comfort of home, without the requirement to attend classes in a physical location. Our online students study their degree through ilearn, Arden’s university campus in the cloud. ilearn provides everything you need to study at university. It offers an integrated virtual learning experience, including your virtual classroom, lecture theatre, and access to our Library Portal. The portal includes an extensive digital library including thousands of journal titles, eBooks, and academic and industry databases which you can use to research your assignments and projects. All of these materials are provided to you free of charge, and contain all the research information you’ll need to complete your degree with us. ilearn is also integrated with Zoom, making it easier to chat with your course tutor during your scheduled seminar sessions. You can even integrate our study materials into your Kindle, making it possible to study wherever you have your Kindle handy. Studying online doesn’t mean studying alone. As well as receiving regular feedback and guidance from your course tutor, you’ll be studying with like-minded students who you can meet with through our Unitu community, and you’ll have access to community message boards to discuss your course and the topics being raised within it. We’ve even set up community boards embedded into each of the course modules so you can have discussions with your tutor and classmates on the topics you’re currently learning. Online learning students resident in the UK can apply for a Maintenance Loan if they cannot attend their course in person because of a disability. Please find more information on our fees and funding page. If you're a student from Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland you can find information on Living Cost Loans from your student finance body. Full time, blended learning How does it work? Our blended learning study mode combines structured in-person learning with the flexibility of guided independent study. You’ll attend eight hours of timetabled, face-to-face classes each week, spread over two days at your chosen Arden University campus. Alongside this, you’ll spend approximately 25 hours each week on independent study. You’ll use iLearn, our digital learning platform, to access key resources, submit assignments, and stay connected with your tutors and classmates. Whether you prefer studying in our on-campus learning spaces or at home, you’ll be supported throughout your journey. Blended learning is ideal if you value regular in-person teaching and want the flexibility to balance your studies with other commitments. With classes concentrated over just two days, you’ll have more control over your time, while still benefiting from face-to-face interaction and access to university facilities. This course is also available to study full-time at our Berlin, Germany campus. Learn more about Blended Learning Entry requirements At Arden University we consider applications on a case by case basis. If you have significant work experience, have qualifications you have gained elsewhere, or a degree or qualification that isn't a clear pathway to this degree - we are more than happy to discuss your application. Standard entry requirements: A 2.2 Honours degree in a computing-related subject, or an equivalent 2.2 Honours degree with 18 months of relevant computing work experience. Typical non-standard entry requirements: A minimum of 3 years of relevant computing work experience. Your work experience should be in a computing or IT role. English proficiency Online Learning: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 90; or equivalent Blended Learning in the UK or full-time study in Berlin: IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element); or TOEFL iBT 60-78; or equivalent. Free English language support is also available at the Arden Berlin campus. Alternatively, evidence you have previously studied in English; a letter to show that the Medium of Instruction was in English can be accepted If you require a visa to study in the UK You must meet the academic entry requirements for this course. You’ll need an IELTS score of 6.0 (with no less than 5.5 in any element) or an equivalent Secure English Language Test (SELT) result. You can find more information here Course fees and funding Funding and Scholarships We also offer a range of scholarships and funding support for eligible students, including options for UK, international, and UK-based international students. Meet the faculty Dr Steve Johnston joined Arden University in November 2025 as the new Associate Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences and Technology. Steve holds an undergraduate degree in Astrophysics and Psychology from Keele University and earned a PhD at the Centre for Applied Mathematics and Computation (CAMAC) in Coventry in 2002. After early experience developing software for a 3D scanning firm, Steve transitioned to academia, focusing on brain imaging research at Bangor University. Following this, Steve lectured in Psychology at Brunel University before joining Swansea University in 2012 as Senior Lecturer. He became Associate Dean for the Faculty of Medicine, Health and Life Science in 2021 where he led the delivery of traditional and professional healthcare programmes, drove curriculum innovation, and implemented enhancement strategies informed by data-driven insights. He is a Fellow of the Higher Education Academy. Steve Johnston Acting Head of School – School of Applied Technology and AI Career prospects 100% of our Masters students studying a computing subject are employed within 2 years of graduation* *Source: 2020/21 Graduate Outcomes Survey Right now, careers in cyber security are positively thriving, driven by the relentless surge in cyber threats which businesses and organisations face. This demand has led to very competitive salaries, often surpassing those of other comparable professions. Career advice Data analytics articles related courses MSc Data Science What will the MSc Cyber Security do for me? Studying Arden University's MSc Cyber Security programme offers you a transformative opportunity to advance your career in a highly lucrative area of employment. In our era of escalating cyber threats and high demand for experts in the field, this degree guarantees you’ll learn cutting-edge knowledge and hands-on skills. With additional free access to industry certifications, practical experience, and alignment with industry standards, enrolling on the course paves the way for a successful future. Other key benefits for you include: Arden University has a diverse workforce, and your studies will be supported by a department of committed and enthusiastic senior lecturers and lecturers who are experts in their chosen fields and draw upon a wealth of academic and industry experience. In addition, many of our academic staff are members of professional and regulatory bodies. NCSC alignment: Our programme content aligns with the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), ensuring you learn the most up-to-date and relevant skills. Additional certifications: We offer access to a choice of certifications and badges through industry-leading organisations. This enhances your career prospects and opens doors to exciting opportunities. Free vendor courses: Gain technical skills through free vendor courses like Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals, listed among Forbes' 8 best Cyber Security Certifications for 2023. All the course content is completely free to our students, you’ll only have to pay for the exam. Cisco badges: Earn a series of Cisco badges such as in Linux and Python for free, further enhancing your expertise and employability. What can I do after Arden University? The modules you will study on this course each give you the underpinning you need to pursue or develop a well-paid and future-proof career in almost any field within cyber security. Here’s a breakdown: Information Security Management module Future careers: Cyber Risk Manager, Cyber Risk Analyst, Cyber Research Analyst, Cyber Incident Manager, or Information Security Manager. Networks Security module Future careers: Cyber Risk Manager, Cyber Risk Analyst, Cyber Research Analyst, Cyber Incident Manager, Cyber Security Engineer, or Cyber Security Design Engineer. Cloud and Web Services Security module Future careers: Web Application Security Analyst, Web Application Tester, Security Operation Centre (SOC) Analyst, or Solution Architects. Digital Forensics and Incident Management module Future careers: Cyber Risk Manager, Cyber Risk Analyst, Cyber Research Analyst, Cyber Incident Manager, Cyber Security Engineer, or Cyber Security Design. Offensive Security module Future careers: Penetration Tester, Information Security Coordinator, Network Security Pen Tester, Web Application Pen Tester, Cyber Risk Manager, Cyber Risk Analyst, or Cyber Research Analyst. Secure System Design module Future careers: IT Security Consultant, Security Architect, Systems Administrator, or Information Security Analyst. Our Masters students studying a computing subject have gone onto earn up to £90,000 within 2 years of graduation* *Source: 2020/21 Graduate Outcomes Survey Industry skills EC Council Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) This certification is a comprehensive programme that trains individuals in ethical hacking and penetration testing techniques. It covers topics such as network security, vulnerability assessment, and countermeasures, enabling professionals to identify and address security vulnerabilities. CEH is highly respected in the cyber security industry, making it a sought-after credential for ethical hackers and security experts. Arden provides the course content free of charge and will cover the cost of the CEH exam. Students will only need to pay an administration fee. NCSC alignment Our programme content aligns with the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), ensuring you learn the most up-to-date and relevant skills. The course has been aligned to the NCSC accreditation framework, which consists of the following five security disciplines: Human, Organisation and Regulatory, Attack & Defence, System Security, Software Security, and Infrastructure Security.  Indicative topic coverage of the knowledge areas within these disciplines has been integrated into the modules and will be included as key content on the programme. Arden students will receive the course content to select Microsoft Learn courses for free and only need to pay for the exam. These include: Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900) An introductory course designed to provide essential knowledge about Microsoft's security and compliance solutions. It covers key concepts, including threat protection, identity management, and information protection, enabling learners to understand and navigate Microsoft's robust security ecosystem. This certification is a foundational step for those looking to pursue a career in Microsoft's security and compliance domain. Microsoft Azure Security Technologies (AZ-500T00) An advanced-level course focusing on security solutions within the Azure cloud platform. It equips learners with the skills to implement security controls, detect and respond to security threats, and protect data and applications on Azure. AZ-500T00 is essential for professionals seeking expertise in Azure security. Cisco Network Academy Cisco offers a range of cyber security training courses, equipping professionals with skills vital for safeguarding networks and data. Arden University is a Cisco Network Academy. On our MSc Cyber Security, you’ll receive Cisco resources so you can self-study and add many of the Cisco networking, cyber, coding, and OSes digital badges to your CV. All these resources, which can cost upwards of thousands of pounds, are completely free for Arden students. Education for everyone, everywhere Whether you're constrained by location, cost, time, or other life commitments, we're passionate about giving you access to higher education that fits into your busy, modern life. You decide how and where to study We offer a wide range of flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in both our online and blended study modes. Course Overview Across international organisations, governments, industries, and services we find supply chains of systems, people, resources, and information that are all vital in keeping the world moving. On our Supply Chain Management and Logistics course you’ll be guided and supported by lecturers with extensive professional experience. The team behind this course have also been instrumental in commercial and policy formation of supply chains with European Commission and the UK Government. Now, more than ever, it is vital for businesses across all industries to invest in their supply chains and embrace the latest digital technologies to optimise supply chain operations. As you study this course you’ll develop strategic operations skills that are highly sought after in any sector offering a product or service. Through a blend of core and optional course modules, you’ll get ready to address the challenges created by today's competitive, omni-channel supply chain environment and learn how to develop an agile, customer responsive, and profitable supply chain. Having been devised in consultation with leading employers in supply chain, this is a modern degree that will teach you skills that are in desperate need within the industry, including cutting edge digital practices such as blockchain, security, and governance. This will prepare you to tackle new challenges in the modern supply chain environment, such as financial fraud and sanctions violations. Importantly, you’ll find that the course takes a systematic view to supply chain, with each module building on the knowledge gained in the previous one, with interconnected content that helps you accumulate new skills in a logical sequence. The course is accredited by the Chartered Institute of Logistics and Transport (CILT) and the Chartered Institute of Procurement & Supply (CIPS). This offers full exemption from the educational requirements for Chartered Membership of both CILT and CIPS, providing you with access to a wealth of industry resources, and speeding up your journey to Chartered Membership of CILT. For full details on your module content, click here to download the brochure . How do we assess you? Assessments Unlike on more traditional degree courses, you won’t be sitting any exams on this MSc. Assessments on our master’s in MSc Supply Chain Management and Logistics have been designed to help you apply your learning to real-word scenarios. This means you’ll have the opportunity to align your studies to how you’ll help transform your organisation’s supply chain operations and functions once you have completed the course. Practice-driven Your course assessments will be practice-driven, focusing on your experience as an industry practitioner while encouraging peer-to-peer sharing and ideation. This modern approach will encourage you to apply your knowledge to organisational challenges systematically and with an in-depth awareness of what is at stake. Business Transformation Project The MSc Supply Chain Management and Logistics concludes with an independent study assessment which forms the Business Transformation Project module. You’ll identify an area of digital business transformation which is of interest to you and then apply your own research and discoveries to the topic, building upon your learning from previous course modules and developing a managerial digital transformation plan related to your own organisation, or one you are familiar with. Other assessment methods Throughout the course you’ll have the opportunity to apply your learning through additional assessments including: Reflective analysis Supply chain plans Stakeholder engagement plans Supply chain models and engines Software appraisals work Supply chain transformation strategies Study options This course is available to study full-time at our campus in Berlin, Germany, or through our blended learning study mode in London Stratford and Manchester. The course is also available to students via online learning. This gives you the convenience of being able to study from anywhere in the UK or worldwide, providing you with the same high standards of teaching but with lower tuition fees. Abdulrahaman Usman Master of Business Administration Full-time blended learning How does it work? Our blended learning study mode combines structured in-person learning with the flexibility of guided independent study. You’ll attend eight hours of timetabled, face-to-face classes each week, spread over two days at your chosen Arden University campus. Alongside this, you’ll spend approximately 25 hours each week on independent study. You’ll use iLearn, our digital learning platform, to access key resources, submit assignments, and stay connected with your tutors and classmates. Whether you prefer studying in our on-campus learning spaces or at home, you’ll be supported throughout your journey. Blended learning is ideal if you value regular in-person teaching and want the flexibility to balance your studies with other commitments. With classes concentrated over just two days, you’ll have more control over your time, while still benefiting from face-to-face interaction and access to university facilities. This course is also available to study full-time at our Berlin, Germany campus. Learn more about blended learning Part-time online learning How does it work? Meet the faculty Hello, I am Dr Malgorzata Radomska, the Head of Department for Supply Chain and Project Management at Arden University. I am passionate about connecting academic learning with industry needs and empowering learners to lead and innovate in complex business environments. I hold a PhD in Public Policy and Governance from Sciences Po Paris, an MBA from the University of Winchester, an MA in Transnational Studies from the University of Southampton, and an undergraduate degree from the London School of Economics and Political Science. I am also a Chartered Manager (CMgr) with the Chartered Management Institute (CMI), a qualified PRINCE2 project manager, and a certified practitioner in both Lean and Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt). My expertise lies in applying these methodologies to drive process improvement, operational efficiency, and quality enhancement across a range of business contexts. In addition, I am a Senior Fellow of Advance HE, which reflects my leadership in academic practice, commitment to inclusive and impactful education, and dedication to student success. With over 15 years of experience across higher education and professional practice, I have developed and led programmes in Business Management, Project Management, International Business, MBA and DBA, including Degree Apprenticeship programmes. I have led and supported research and knowledge exchange projects exceeding £10 million in value and have built strong partnerships with SMEs, public sector bodies, and community organisations to deliver real-world impact and employability-focused education. Prior to joining Arden, I was Head of Department for Responsible Management and Leadership at the University of Winchester, where I led initiatives in teaching excellence, stakeholder engagement, and cross-disciplinary collaboration. Dr Malgorzata Radomska Head of Department for Supply Chain and Project Management Career prospects Supply chain management is a key skill for any business that offers a service or product, so the career opportunities are vast. Supply chain is one the few areas that touches almost every industry, and has employment opportunities globally. Joining this course is a fantastic opportunity for international students who want to progress in the supply chain professions to boost their career impact and earning potential. Your master’s degree will give you the skills you need to demonstrate senior-level management expertise, enhancing your CV for future employers. So, wherever you want to take your career next, the choice is yours. Related Courses Master of Business Administration (MBA) MSc Business Transformation MSc Strategic Digital Marketing Business and Management Articles Career Advice What will the MSc in Supply Chain Management and Logistics do for my career? Understanding how to digitise, economise, and optimise a supply chain is a highly desirable skill. That’s why your course will focus on real-world practice, giving you the opportunity to apply what you learn to real business scenarios. Guest speakers and lecturers from industry will also inform you about the latest developments in the sector as you progress through your studies. Some of the key learnings you’ll take away from this course include: Developing a variety of transferable skills suited to an extensive range of supply chain and operations roles. Evaluating options for enhancing supply chain efficiency in the digital business environment. Analysing Big Data sets to identify supply chain forecasts, trends, and plans. Designing agile, sustainable and flexible supply chain engines for success in the digital business environment. Evaluating the contribution of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and robotics in contemporary supply chain management. Exploring the various digital technologies, software applications and business models that might be employed to maximise supply chain efficiency and sustainability in the global business environment. Evaluating methodologies for data analysis and modelling, develop and evaluate supply chain plans and explore the importance of people management when building effective supply chain relationships. Analysing relevant theory, case material and the enabling technologies that might be deployed to optimise supply chain performance. Gaining multifunctional skills that will maximise your employability and career potential. According to the 2022 CIPS Procurement Salary Guide, 56% of employers request MCIPS or studying towards it when recruiting. Employees with CIPS credentials earn an average of 21% more than those without. What can I do after Arden University? The MSc Supply Chain Management and Logistics will help you develop the skills you need to accelerate your career to a senior management or leadership role in change and digital transformation within the supply chain profession. The course has been extensively informed by leading names in industry including Amazon, Mail, Kuehne & Nagel, Coca Cola, and Nestlé, who have identified current skills gaps in supply chain across the global workforce. This means you’ll learn skills and competencies that are needed today by some of the world’s most prominent and influential employers. So whether you want to join or continue working for an already established business, start your own company, or become a consultant, the course will give you everything you need to explore multiple career paths. Some roles you may want to consider after graduation include: Supply chain solution design analyst Supply chain IT & cyber specialist Logistics manager/director Strategic sourcing manager Buyer Procurement manager/specialist Commodities manager Quality manager Production planner Purchasing manager Industry skills Chartered Institute of Logistics and Transport The Chartered Institute of Logistics and Transport (CILT) is the leading international voice for supply chain, logistics, and transport. The organisation is regarded as the leading professional body globally by those both within and outside the profession. The CILT is passionate about your education and provides a number of useful membership services. Established in 1919 the organisation now has a presence in more than 30 countries worldwide, influencing and shaping government policy across many economies and providing education and training at all levels and in all sectors. Chartered Institute of Procurement & Supply Chartered Institute of Procurement & Supply (CIPS) is a UK-based global professional body which aims to promote and develop high standards of professional skill, ability, and integrity among all those engaged in purchasing and supply chain management. The CIPS is also committed to the promotion of good practice cross the industry, and provides highly beneficial networking opportunities across a global network to its current membership of more than 100,000 individuals. As a CIPS-accredited degree, this programme offers full exemption from the educational requirements for Chartered Membership. You’ll also have free membership to the CIPS throughout your studies, giving you access to a wealth of valuable academic and professional resources. These include the CIPS intelligence hub and Supply Management magazine, self-assessment tools, career and continued professional development support, and global networking opportunities. And you’ll have the opportunity to sit the CIPS Ethical Procurement and Supply certificate free of charge, which is a prerequisite for Chartered Membership. Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) membership. Arden University is a member of the prestigious Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). AACSB International is a global association of leaders in education and business dedicated to supporting and advancing quality business education worldwide. This membership reflects the fact that Arden University has successfully matched the high standards required by the AACSB, and enables the sharing of ideas and the exchange best practises between global business schools. Membership also gives our faculty members access to in-depth data and research to support the development of our courses and teaching methods, ensuring that we are able to provide you with the best possible university experience. Business Graduates Association The BGA is a membership and quality assurance body. As a member, Arden University have signed up to the BGA Charter, committing their institution to responsible management practices and lifelong learning, positively impacting their students, communities, and the economy. This shows our students that we are demonstrating responsible management ourselves, as well as it being a central theme that runs through our own courses. As Arden University is a member of the Business Graduates Association (BGA), students will receive complementary BGA student and graduate membership. Through this membership, current students will have access to the BGA Career Development Centre, packed with interactive tools, e-learning content, partner discounts and the latest job opportunities. This is a lifetime access, which means students will continue to have access to these services even after they graduate.
